items.title: Rockchip measures Spark-X2.5 1.7B at 13.6 to 15.6 tok/s on RK3576 and RK3588 NPUs
items.summary: Rockchip's RKNN-LLM benchmark shows the 1.7B Spark-X2.5 model at 13.57 tok/s in 1,029 MB (W4A16, RK3576) and 15.61 tok/s in 1,830 MB (W8A8, RK3588), with 128 input and 64 output tokens. Useful for people running small LLMs on low-cost ARM boards.

items.title: TensorFold 1.3.3 reaches 172 tok/s on GLM 5.3 Flash after a 1M-token prompt on 4 DGX Sparks
items.summary: A new long-context kernel in TensorFold 1.3.3 lifts decode after a 1M-token prompt from 151.5 to 172 tok/s on four DGX Sparks running GLM 5.3 Flash, with identical output tokens. Relevant to long-context local serving.

doubt.pushback: Quote of another user's measurement; not independently reproduced.

items.title: Inkling 2 Mini 4-bit files (17 to 18 GB) spill to CPU on a 16 GB GPU: 43 tok/s on RTX 5060 Ti versus 417 on a 32 GB 5090
items.summary: Reported numbers for Inkling 2 Mini show 43.1 tok/s on a 16 GB RTX 5060 Ti (part of the model on CPU) versus 416.6 on a 32 GB 5090, which also used draft tokens in vLLM, so the comparison is not clean. Practical sizing guidance for local runners.

doubt.pushback: Author notes the two runs differ (vLLM draft tokens on the 5090); quote of another user's measurement.

items.title: InPlace open-source iPhone dictation keyboard adds a language key for Apple's on-device speech model
items.summary: InPlace, a reference dictation keyboard for iPhone built on Apple's on-device speech model, now has an EN/FR key to pick the language before speaking, since the model listens in one language at a time.

items.title: pi-H3 makes MiniMax H3 video generation open source, 2 to 4 steps with no VAE decoder
items.summary: pi-H3 distills MiniMax H3 to 2 to 4 steps without a VAE decoder; the author reports 768p video faster than real time on one B200 and under 40 s on one RTX 3090 via ComfyUI. Weights, a demo Space, code and a ComfyUI node are released.

doubt.pushback: Speed figures are the author's own; not deep-read.

items.title: tiny-voca open-source voice model gains 20 community-trained languages in a week
items.summary: One week after tiny-voca was open sourced as English-only, the community trained 20 more languages for it; the author links all of them. Relevant to small on-device speech use.

doubt.pushback: Links sit in a reply that was not read; nothing checked here.

items.title: Magnitude to release SSD expert-streaming engine for sparse MoE models, claims DeepSeek V4.1 Flash at 40+ tok/s on one gaming GPU
items.summary: Magnitude previews an engine that streams MoE experts from NVMe with expert caching, speculative lookahead and streaming prefill, claiming ~40+ tok/s for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on a single GPU. Release is said to be Monday; a GitHub repo is linked.

doubt.pushback: Speed is a vendor claim ahead of release; no benchmark or reproduction shown.

reception.summary: The 20 most recent replies were mostly enthusiasm, a Grok explainer and short questions (NAS with big RAM, why not earlier); nobody reported trying it.
